section.sectionSummaryBrief: These three aspects (Filling, Surrounding, and Atzmus Ein Sof) have parallels in man, showing that the service of Shofros relates to the essence of the soul and must be expressed specifically through the inanimate aspect of man and a physical shofar.
section.t: And behold, these three matters
(Filling, Surrounding, and Atzmus Ein Sof)
have, so to speak, their parallel in man.
For since man is a microcosm of the Above,
therefore there is in him a parallel to all the matters that are above.
For the internal powers in man,
which are revealed in the limbs of the body,
are a parallel to the Filling light that clothes itself and influences the worlds in a revealed manner83.
And the encompassing powers in man,
like the will that acts upon all the powers and limbs but is not revealed in them84,
are a parallel to the Surrounding light85
whose influence on the worlds is in concealment83.
And the essence of the soul, which is above even the encompassing powers, is a parallel to Atzmus Ein Sof.
And from this it is understood,
that the services of Malchiyos and Zichronos are in the powers
(internal and encompassing)
of the soul,
and the service of Shofros is in the essence of the soul.
And as mentioned above,
that the sound of the shofar is an inner voice from the innerness of the heart.
And behold, although the matter of the shofar is an inner cry from the innerness of the heart,
nevertheless,
the cry must be specifically through a blast in a physical shofar,
a shofar of a lamb or ram,
a living being
(which is below the level of speech),
as explained in the aforementioned discourse of the Tzemach Tzedek86,
and moreover,
that the horn of the shofar must be detached
(from the lamb or ram),
inanimate.
For from this it is understood also in spiritual service,
that the service of the shofar, despite being from the innerness and essence of the soul,
must be
(also)
in the inanimate aspect of man.
And specifically through this, the inner cry from the innerness of the heart is aroused and revealed.
And in the known manner87
regarding the matter of inanimate, vegetative, animate, and speaking in man, that specifically the inanimate in man relates to the speaking within him,
so too is it regarding the encompassing aspects of man, which are above the distinctions of levels of inanimate, vegetative, animate, and speaking
(parallel to the Surrounding light, which is above the distinctions of levels of the chain of descent),
and also in the essence of the soul
(which is above even the encompassing powers),
that their arousal and revelation is specifically through the inanimate in man.
And therefore one must blow specifically a physical shofar,
inanimate,
for the revelation of the inner voice from the innerness of the heart is not in the will of the head
(Galgaltha),
and certainly it is not revealed and clothed in Chabad of the intellect or in the emotions of the heart,
but rather specifically in the inanimate within him,
the service of acceptance of the yoke,
the inanimate of the human soul
[And in the known manner88
regarding the matter of lower awe, that specifically through it the aspect of higher awe is revealed],
and lower than that – the matter of action
(which relates to the inanimate of the human body),
the blast of a physical shofar.
And to the extent that this matter
(the blowing of the shofar in action)
specifically is the singular commandment – the commandment of the day of Rosh Hashanah,
as our sages said89
"The commandment of the day is with the shofar."
And with this will be understood the statement of my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe90
in the name of the Alter Rebbe
(in connection with Rosh Hashanah)
"One has absolutely no comprehension
of how precious the body of a Jew is to the Holy One, blessed be He,"
for the intention is not that even the body is precious to the Holy One, blessed be He,
but rather that the main preciousness is in the body.
For this is what he says, "One has absolutely no comprehension,"
because the preciousness of the body is beyond comprehension and understanding,
for the preciousness of the body of a Jew
(inanimate)
is from the aspect of Atzmus91.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Since G-d desired a dwelling in the lower worlds, the inner voice must be revealed specifically through a physical animal shofar, which is inanimate, thereby perfecting the divine intent.
section.t: And one may add,
that since the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower worlds,
that even the physical world
(outside of man)
should be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
therefore it is not sufficient that the inner voice
(the aspect of the innerness of the heart)
is revealed through the inanimate
(acceptance of the yoke,
and action)
within man,
but rather the revelation of this voice
(the inner voice,
from the aspect of the innerness of the heart)
must be through a shofar of an animal,
and in this itself,
as it is severed from its source of life,
inanimate,
for specifically through this does man effect
(also)
in the world
(and in its inanimate aspect)
that it should be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He.
In a parallel to how it was on Rosh Hashanah the first time,
when Adam the First effected
(also)
in the creations
(outside of himself)
that there should be in them "we will prostrate and bow, we will kneel before the Lord our Maker."
And this matter of the shofar
[the blowing of the shofar in physicality,
in a shofar of an animal,
and as it is made inanimate]
is from the term "improve your deeds" (shapru ma'aseichem),
the innerness of delight
(as above),
for specifically through this is perfected the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired.
And so it is also in the simple understanding of matters, that the satisfaction and delight above this, that "My will is done"
[for this satisfaction is the innerness of delight,
above the delight of "He desires kindness"
(as above in section 3)]
is from the fulfillment of the commandment in its simple physicality
(in an inanimate shofar of an animal),
"My will is done."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The satisfaction of "My will is done" exists throughout the year, but on Rosh Hashanah it is the main commandment of the day, and its elevation depends on the service throughout the year; since every Jew is presumed fit, especially after Elul, they stand ready for judgment with joy.
section.t: And 4)
And behold, the satisfaction and delight above this, that "My will is done," is throughout the year,
except that on Rosh Hashanah it is the main commandment of the day, etc.,
and the elevation that occurs on Rosh Hashanah is according to the manner of service and the satisfaction brought about through it during the entire year.
For when Israel increase
(in their service,
and consequently)
in the satisfaction throughout the year,
there is also an increase in the satisfaction from "My will is done" on Rosh Hashanah.
And since each and every Jew certainly effected in the past year all the matters,
all Jews are in the presumptive state of fitness92,
for the matter of presumption (chazakah) is a strong pillar in the Torah,
and particularly after the service of the month of Elul,
and in Elul itself after the 18th of Elul, which infuses vitality into all the matters of the month of Elul93
[in addition to it being the luminous day on which the two great luminaries were born94],
then the presumptive fitness of each and every Jew is with greater strength and power,
and from day to day
(in the days from the 18th of Elul onward)
the fitness of each and every Jew is in a manner of increasing and adding light,
and particularly in the days of Selichos,
behold it is clear that "you are standing today, all of you"95,
as stated in the portion that was read on the Shabbos from which96
all the days are blessed,
and according to the explanation of the Baal Shem Tov97
that "today" refers to Rosh Hashanah98
which is the day of judgment,
and "you"
(each and every Jew,
all of you)
"are standing" – existing and enduring, that they prevail in judgment,
for this matter
(prevailing in judgment)
already exists on the eve of Rosh Hashanah,
therefore on the eve of Rosh Hashanah they wear white and wrap themselves in white99
etc.,
and they go with joy,
and with great joy100,
to crown the King on Rosh Hashanah,
for already on the eve of Rosh Hashanah all the necessary preparations exist,
for joy breaks all boundaries101.
And this also serves as a close preparation for "the breaker will go up before us" very soon,
that with a good inscription and sealing for a good and sweet year, it will be included and emphasized that the year will be a year of redemption,
the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
"the breaker will go up before us,"
and speedily in our actual days.
